decisions.negative: a called symbol must never be flagged — this is the false-positive guard, asserted per language
decisions.positive: an unreferenced symbol must be flagged — beyond TS/Python (Ruby, Go, Java, Python)
decisions.entryPoints: fixture names avoid the built-in entry-point exclusions so the real detector path is exercised

limitations: Orphan detection is static index evidence; dynamic dispatch/reflection remains a documented limitation of the detector itself.
